statement: Canonical Transcendental Continuation Diagram, Arithmetic Preservation, and Impossibility of Concrete Collision Witness: For intrinsic arithmetic A = (N_{>=1}, +, *, <=), each integer grade representation iota_K(n) = tau^K * n (tau = 2*pi, K in Z) embeds into an externally disjoint layer L_K = tau^K N_{>=1} with transported operations +_K and *_K. The canonical commutative diagram establishes: (1) Preservation: iota_K is an exact isomorphism of ordered semirings, and the induced raw external Dirichlet series D_K(s) = sum_{x in L_K} x^{-s} = tau^{-Ks} * zeta(s) has identical zero divisor div(D_K) = div(zeta) = sum_rho m_rho [rho]. The zero coordinates are strictly fixed and invariant across all grades (distinct from frequency-dilated Z_K(s) = zeta(tau^{-K}s) or centered coordinate dilation). (2) Layer Disjointness: By the transcendence of tau = 2*pi (Lindemann 1882), tau^{K-J} is transcendental for K != J, forcing L_K \cap L_J = \emptyset for all distinct integer grades. (3) Impossibility of Concrete Collision Witness: Any candidate collision witness W(rho, K, J, m, n) requires an arithmetic incidence m * tau^K = n * tau^J (W2), which is impossible for non-zero integers m, n. Furthermore, the canonical inverse map (Perron inversion / explicit formula) introduces zeros rho only as smooth continuous spectral modulations x^rho/rho on (0, infty) with no jump discontinuities. Jump discontinuities of psi_K occur strictly at intrinsic prime powers tau^K p^k in L_K. An off-critical zero (delta != 0) alters the amplitude envelope between jumps but cannot alter jump locations or create discrete arithmetic events in L_K \cap L_J. Lean formalizes the exact algebraic isomorphism of (L_K, +_K, *_K) and the injectivity of grade exponential dilation under Mathlib foundational axioms. Therefore, no concrete collision witness exists under presently defined TC maps: arithmetic preservation and external layer separation remain disconnected.

hypotheses: A = (N_{>=1}, +, *, <=) is the intrinsic ordered semiring of positive integers
iota_K(n) = tau^K * n defines layer L_K = tau^K N_{>=1}
add_K(x, y) = x + y and mul_K(x, y) = tau^{-K} * x * y on L_K
D_K(s) = sum_{x in L_K} x^{-s} = tau^{-Ks} * zeta(s) for Re(s) > 1
object_studied: Canonical TC commutative diagram, grade isomorphism iota_K, layer disjointness L_K \cap L_J = \emptyset, and candidate collision witnesses W(rho, K, J, m, n)
fourier_normalization: Additive Fourier-Laplace transform on R; Mellin transform on R_+
multiplicity_convention: Nontrivial zero multiplicity m_rho >= 1 and discrete grade indexing K, J in Z
measure_and_window: Counting measure on discrete layers L_K; Lebesgue measure dx on R_+
order_of_limits: Dirichlet series sum limit N -> infty; discrete grade index difference |K - J| >= 1
exact_conclusion: Preservation holds identically: iota_K is an exact arithmetic isomorphism and div(D_K) = div(zeta) has fixed zero coordinates for all K. However, no concrete collision witness W exists under present TC maps because L_K \cap L_J = \emptyset by the transcendence of 2*pi, and explicit formula zero modes x^rho/rho are continuous with no discrete jump incidence.
logical_negation: iota_K fails to be an isomorphism, or D_K has scaled zeros differing from zeta, or non-zero integers satisfy m*tau^K = n*tau^J for K != J, or an off-critical zero forces a discrete jump collision across layers (FALSIFIED / REFUTED)
falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 4 (Arithmetic Isomorphism & Equality-Case Audit): proved that iota_K(m + n) = add_K(iota_K m, iota_K n) and iota_K(m * n) = mul_K(iota_K m, iota_K n) hold identically with 0 error, establishing exact semiring isomorphism

Gate 2 & 5 (Zero Divisor Rigidity & Boundary Dominance): proved that D_K(s) = tau^{-Ks} * zeta(s) has identical zeros to zeta(s) because tau^{-Ks} is everywhere non-vanishing on C, with boundary dominance in the asymptotic limit Re(s) -> infty governed by tau^{-Ks}; confirmed that zero coordinates are strictly fixed, disproving the misconception that arithmetic scaling induces scaled zeros {tau^K rho}

Gate 3 & 9 (Transcendental Layer Disjointness & Collision Impossibility): tested candidate incidence m*tau^K = n*tau^J against Lindemann (1882); proved that tau^{K-J} is transcendental for K != J and can never equal rational n/m, proving L_K \cap L_J = \emptyset and refuting condition W2

Gate 6 & 7 (Canonical Inverse Map & Jump Support Separation): evaluated explicit formula zero modes x^rho/rho; proved they are C^infty on (0, infty) with NO jump discontinuities, while jumps of psi_K occur strictly at tau^K p^k in L_K, refuting condition W3

Gate 8 (Independence & Non-Circularity Audit): proved the negative result without assuming RH, temperedness, or polynomial bounds, demonstrating that lack of collision is an unconditional consequence of transcendence and jump support
Gate 10 (Dual Status Classification): marked SPECIFICATION_SCHEMA_PASSED for structural schema gates and validated clean separation between preservation and exclusion
